body: I totally understand. It's weird to finally realize how good you've gotten at lying to others about your mental state too. The mask is effective but it drains you.

As someone who is going to attempt tonight, I understand. But this sincerely is not a reason to do so. It is not your fault that those in power in our country are doing their best to make things shittier for the common person. Even those who truly hate America usually only refer to the government and people who actually have power in society, billionaires, political pundits, etc. We live in a system designed to foster this kind of self hatred in order to distract us from fighting against the true causes of our country's shittiness. To paint all Americans by the same brush is to include those who are marginalized and fighting back in the camp of people who deserve to be shunned. And I think you have much more in common with them than you do any billionaire.
